name: groundcrew
title: Groundcrew
description: Browse and monitor tasks managed by the Groundcrew CLI.
author: shubhsherl

preferences.name: crewPath
preferences.title: Groundcrew Executable Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the crew executable. Leave blank to auto-discover from PATH, Homebrew, or an nvm install. Set it explicitly for other setups (fnm, asdf, or a wrapper script) — see the extension README.

preferences.name: editorApp
preferences.title: Editor Application
preferences.description: Application used for "Open in Editor" on a task worktree (e.g. Visual Studio Code, Cursor). Leave blank to use the macOS "Open With" picker.

preferences.name: additionalPath
preferences.title: Additional PATH
preferences.description: Colon-separated directories prepended to PATH when crew runs, so crew and the tools it shells out to (node, git, cmux, gh) resolve under Raycast's stripped environment. Supports ~ and $HOME. Find them with `dirname $(which crew node git cmux gh)`.

preferences.name: linearApiKey
preferences.title: Linear API Key
preferences.description: Optional Linear API key exported to crew as GROUNDCREW_LINEAR_API_KEY. Set it only if crew can't otherwise read your key under Raycast's stripped environment. Stored locally in Raycast; never sent anywhere else.

commands.name: browse-groundcrew-tasks
commands.title: Browse Groundcrew Tasks
commands.description: Browse tasks managed by the local Groundcrew CLI.

commands.name: groundcrew-status
commands.title: Groundcrew Status
commands.description: View the status of the local Groundcrew CLI.

commands.name: start-groundcrew-task
commands.title: Start Groundcrew Task
commands.description: Start a Groundcrew task by ticket number.

commands.name: groundcrew-doctor
commands.title: Groundcrew Doctor
commands.description: Diagnose Groundcrew host prerequisites, configuration, and Linear reachability.

commands.name: open-groundcrew-workspace
commands.title: Open Groundcrew Workspace
commands.description: Open an existing pull request or branch in a Groundcrew worktree.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
